//: Copy this file to visualizer.export.json (git-ignored) and edit the paths.
//projectRoot: Absolute path to your TeamCode Java SOURCE ROOT — the folder that directly contains 'org/'. On a stock FTC project that is .../TeamCode/src/main/java
//packages: Where visualizer output goes, RELATIVE to projectRoot. Keep these separate from your hand-written code so you always know which classes came from the visualizer. The Java 'package' line in each generated file is derived from these paths.
//allowGit: When true, the bridge reports the current git branch / dirty state in the export panel (read-only, it never commits for you).
